summary: mypy checks lib/ansible/ and ansible-test internals against controller Python versions, and modules and module_utils against target-only versions too.
questions: Which code does the mypy sanity test check?

answer_card.title: mypy sanity test
answer_card.answer_md:
- Against controller Pythons: `lib/ansible/`, `test/lib/ansible_test/_internal/`
- Also against target-only Pythons: `lib/ansible/modules/`, `lib/ansible/module_utils/`
